decisions.rationale: Approve the B6 hybrid as the basis for B7. The ledger-first wide-screen composition and mobile entry → balance/summary → recent history sequence are coherent. The populated mobile and post-submit states show the updated balance and new transaction together. The revised 32×32 delete target is optically centered and correctly placed at the row end; rest remains subordinate, hover is clearly actionable but restrained, active is distinct, keyboard focus remains separate and visible, and the quieter expense accent no longer competes. All seven revision-2 evidence requests are reviewed and satisfied. No further B6 revision is requested.

Adopt this permanent review principle: never ask a human to evaluate a redesign from memory when the exact control is available. Make the frozen control directly reachable alongside the candidate under the same pinned rendering environment. This requires no compare UI; the simple index and routes are sufficient for this experiment.
